scope.acceptance: Given approaching quota limits, when outstanding reservations and shared-client use reduce headroom, optional repair pauses first, quiet-tick reviews next and event reviews/Continuation last, with durable reason/wake state and no shrinking percentage-of-remainder reserve claim.

currentSourceFindings.existingOwner: ModelAdmissionApi in packages/self-improvement/src/model-admission.ts owns durable model_call accounting and single-request reserve/claim/settle/observe/inspect. ModelAdmissionPolicy.evaluate in packages/ops/src/model-admission-policy.ts applies the common named-window admission rules.
currentSourceFindings.existingPendingRows: Denied toy_si.model_call rows already persist work class, expected upper bounds, reservation state, decision reason and retryAt. The row guard freezes request bindings, settled rows, native send count/acknowledgement and charged reservations; it permits mutable admission decision/state for non-settled rows while reservation charging remains monotonic.
currentSourceFindings.missingOwnerBehavior: The public API has no pending-row listing or owner-selected resume operation. inspect returns a single optional record, and reserve handles one request at a time, so a caller could currently determine retry order.
currentSourceFindings.policyBoundary: Use only the source order event/Continuation, then quiet-tick, then optional repair/replay. Check actual shared-client window usage plus current unreflected account-wide reservations and the selected row's existing expected upper bounds against the fixed 60% five-hour and 70% weekly limits. Do not add per-class thresholds or a percentage-of-remainder reserve.
currentSourceFindings.queueBoundary: Treat eligible denied rows already in toy_si.model_call as the deferred-work set. Add no second queue or migration. Do not include settled, uncertain, charged, native-sent, terminally acknowledged, ended, foreground, or foreground-judge rows in resume candidates.
currentSourceFindings.priorRejectedApproach: build/evidence/R0.11/minimum-assigned-at-plan.json rejected caller-sorted requests because they prove caller order, not owner enforcement, and deferred the work. build/evidence/R0.11/run-review-next-minimum-plan.json proposed per-request class-aware preemption but left the pending-order owner absent. This plan replaces both gaps with owner selection over persisted rows; it does not add numeric class cutoffs.
currentSourceFindings.otherBoundary: DurableCadenceOwner owns anchored scheduled slots/reviews, not the shared model admission ledger or all AT-ops-50 work classes. Keep the queue and retry decision in ModelAdmission.

publicMethods: ModelAdmissionApi.inspectPending(accountRef: string): Result<readonly ModelAdmissionRecordV1[]> — read eligible deferred rows from toy_si.model_call in owner priority order, with the actual stored decision.reason and decision.retryAt.

ModelAdmissionApi.resumePending(accountRef: string, callKey: string): Result<ModelAdmissionRecordV1> — re-evaluate only that existing denied row when it is the owner-selected head; a lower-priority callKey is rejected. If the same key is retried after its state changed, return its persisted row idempotently without advancing the queue.
minimumInterface.selection: Select only current-account, current-UTC-day, uncharged denied rows with native_send_count=0, no terminal acknowledgement, ended_at=NULL, a durable retryAt and the assigned autonomous classes. The owner query, not the probe, applies the class priority; stable tie ordering within a tier is an implementation detail and is not an acceptance claim. Include measured OPTIONAL_WORK_PAUSED with durable retryAt from fresh lower-priority holds; do not drop the work the gate itself pauses.
minimumInterface.retrySemantics: Re-evaluate the selected row against a fresh quota observation and account-wide ledger. If still blocked, keep the same row denied and persist the current reason/retryAt. If eligible, transition that same row to reserved under the existing global admission lock, set its charge/lease once, and preserve every frozen request/cost field. Do not decrement a charge, create a replacement call, reopen uncertain work, or issue a provider send. A wrong-head request must not mutate any row.
minimumInterface.canonicalTypes: Add only the two ModelAdmissionApi method signatures using existing ModelAdmissionRecordV1 and string types. No new DTO/schema, generated contract, queue table, migration, work class, or caller-supplied rank is needed. The queue readback is a list of existing canonical record DTOs from the existing durable rows.
minimumInterface.sharedPolicy: Keep ModelAdmissionPolicy's existing fixed 60%/70% arithmetic unchanged. Each resume re-reads shared-client use and outstanding/unknown reservations; no remaining-budget percentage or class-specific numeric cutoff is introduced.
